sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the marriage functions of the applicant will commence from 22.02.2024 and conclude on 27.02.2024.
Invitation card of the marriage has also been filed along with the petition.
Ms. Ayushi Pandey, fiance of the applicant is also present with her counsel.
Hence, interim bail may be granted to the applicant for a period of 45 days.
3. Learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
4. Ms. Ayushi Pandey, fiance of the applicant is also present with her counsel.
She has been duly identified by her counsel and she confirmed the factum of marriage.
4. I have heard learned counsel for the parties and have perused the case diary.

5. In view of the aforesaid submissions and on perusal of the documents filed on record, this Court is inclined to allow the present temporary bail application for a period of 30 days from the date of his release.

6. It is directed that the applicant be released on temporary bail for a period of 30 days from the date of his release upon furnishing a bail bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rs. Fifty Thousand only)
with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for securing his presence before the said Court on all the dates of hearing fixed in this regard during trial.

It is also directed that the applicant shall comply with the provisions of Section 437(3) Cr.P.C..
7.

It is made clear that after having been completed the aforesaid period, the applicant may surrender before the Trial Court, failing which the concerned trial Court is having liberty to arrest the applicant in accordance with law.
Certified copy as per rules.
